name: Survey Sampling & Frame Design
description: Ability to design, evaluate, and implement probability sampling frames and multi-stage selection techniques for government statistical collections.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Understands basic random sampling concepts and primary sampling units.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Able to calculate sample sizes, selection probabilities, and weights for stratified designs.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Formulates multi-stage complex sampling frames, adjusts non-response weights, and calculates variance.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Establishes national sampling standards and innovates master sampling frame design.

name: Macroeconomic Statistics & Price Indices
description: Mastery of System of National Accounts (SNA), inflation measurement, CPI/WPI index computation, and industrial economic data.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Grasps macro-economic concepts, price basket concepts, and basic index formulas.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Compiles monthly index numbers, checks unit price variations, and formats sector GVA estimates.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Conducts base-year revisions, hedonic price adjustments, and national accounts aggregation.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Leads national economic accounting frameworks and international standard alignment.

name: Micro-data Editing, Imputation & Quality Assurance
description: Capability to execute automated data validation rules, outlier detection, and statistical imputation on raw field survey data.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Performs basic range checks and identifies missing microdata fields.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Writes automated data validation scripts and executes deterministic rule-based imputation.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Designs stochastic imputation models (hot-deck/predictive mean matching) and audits edit rules.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Architect end-to-end automated data quality assurance frameworks for national censuses.

name: Statistical Programming with R & Python
description: Proficiency in using R, Python, and statistical packages for reproducible statistical processing and modeling.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Executes basic data loading, filtering, and summary statistical commands in R/Python.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Writes modular scripts for data transformations, survey weighting, and regression analysis.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Builds custom statistical packages, automated data pipelines, and optimized matrix calculations.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Standardizes statistical computing libraries across government statistical organizations.

name: Geospatial Analytics & Census Mapping
description: Skills in integrating spatial GIS boundary data, satellite imagery, and geocoded enumeration blocks into statistical frames.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Views spatial layers, overlays administrative boundary maps, and geocodes field locations.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Performs spatial join queries, constructs digital enumeration maps, and analyzes spatial clustering.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Integrates remote sensing data with survey samples for small area spatial modeling.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Directs spatial data infrastructure policy and national GIS statistical mapping programs.

name: Relational Databases & SDMX Metadata Management
description: Design and management of relational data systems, data structures, and SDMX standard metadata definitions.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Executes SQL SELECT queries and understands primary key relationships.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Constructs database tables, indexes, stored procedures, and basic SDMX structure definitions.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Optimizes complex database schemas, manages SDMX registries, and implements microdata portals.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Architects enterprise statistical data architecture and global metadata exchange pipelines.

name: Official Statistics Quality Frameworks & Policy
description: Understanding UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics, National Quality Assurance Frameworks (NQAF), and data standards.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Familiar with official statistical mandates and basic data quality guidelines.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Applies NQAF quality dimensions (relevance, accuracy, timeliness) during survey operations.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Conducts independent quality evaluations of statistical releases and methodological compliance.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Authors national statistical legislation, quality protocols, and international agreements.

name: Data Visualization & Analytical Reporting
description: Transforming complex statistical datasets into visual dashboards, infographics, and policy-relevant analytical publications.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Creates standard charts, bar graphs, and basic summary tables in BI software.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Builds interactive multi-page dashboards with dynamic filters and drill-down analytics.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Authors comprehensive statistical bulletins with custom data visualizations and narrative context.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Sets organization-wide data visualization design guidelines and public release standards.

name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling for Public Policy
description: Application of supervised and unsupervised machine learning, natural language processing, and anomaly detection to government data.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Understands basic decision tree and linear regression model concepts.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Trains and evaluates classification algorithms for data validation and trend prediction.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Implements deep learning and NLP models on unstructured administrative records.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Establishes AI/ML governance frameworks and predictive analytics strategies in public administration.

name: Field Operations Management & Logistics
description: Planning, deploying, and supervising field enumeration teams, transport logistics, and CAPI (Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing) hardware.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Manages individual field enumeration assignments and CAPI tablet operation.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Coordinates district-level field operations, enumerator deployment, and daily progress tracking.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Oversees state/regional survey logistics, contingency management, and supervisor training.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Directs nationwide census and multi-domain survey field operations.

name: Ethical Data Handling & Respondent Confidentiality
description: Strict compliance with respondent anonymity standards, microdata anonymization techniques, and data protection legislation.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Knows basic confidentiality rules and safe data handling protocols.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Applies disclosure control methods (top-coding, suppression) prior to data release.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Implements differential privacy models and microdata anonymization audits.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Formulates institutional privacy policies, ethics reviews, and data sharing legal frameworks.

name: Technical Communication & Policy Dissemination
description: Communicating statistical uncertainty, methodological details, and key indicator trends to non-technical policy makers and the public.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Drafts clear explanations of statistical terms for routine progress reports.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Authors statistical press releases, methodological notes, and policy briefs.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Conducts media briefings, defends methodological changes, and presents at international forums.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Serves as chief statistical spokesperson and leads national statistical literacy campaigns.

name: Strategic Capacity Development & Institutional Governance
description: Leading organizational vision, human capital capacity building, continuous learning strategy, and inter-agency coordination.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Participates actively in peer training and self-directed skill enhancement.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Mentors junior staff and designs practical technical training modules.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Manages institutional capacity building programs and cross-departmental skill initiatives.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Shapes long-term national statistical workforce strategy and institutional modernization.

name: Statistical Project Planning & Execution
description: Managing project lifecycles, Gantt milestones, task dependencies, and deliverable quality for complex statistical rounds.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Executes assigned project tasks within specified deadlines.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Prepares work breakdown structures, monitors timelines, and tracks milestone completion.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Manages multi-phase statistical programs, resolving bottleneck risks and resource conflicts.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Controls national statistical master schedules across multiple concurrent surveys.

name: Enterprise Data Pipelines & Infrastructure
description: Architecting automated ETL data pipelines, data warehouses, and cloud infrastructure for large administrative data streams.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Understands basic data warehouse concepts and file storage schemas.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Configures routine ETL scripts, scheduled cron jobs, and database sync pipelines.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Designs resilient distributed processing pipelines and hybrid cloud data architectures.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Leads enterprise data platform strategy for nationwide digital statistics.

name: Household & Socio-Economic Survey Methodology
description: Expertise in designing household consumer expenditure, labor force, health, and socio-economic survey schedules.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Understands standard household survey question structures and skip-logic.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Prepares questionnaire blocks, pre-tests schedules, and writes enumerator instruction manuals.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Evaluates non-sampling error, designs computer-assisted questionnaire logic, and tests response rates.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Innovates national socio-economic survey frameworks and indicator harmonization.

name: Analytical Problem Solving & Operational Decision Making
description: Diagnosing non-systematic survey errors, field anomalies, data discrepancies, and technical bottlenecks under pressure.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Identifies basic operational problems and escalates to field supervisors.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Analyzes error logs, diagnoses field data discrepancies, and implements corrective actions.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Solves complex methodological bottlenecks and field crisis situations systematically.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Establishes institutional problem resolution frameworks and resilience protocols.

name: Field Audit, Quality Control & Resource Allocation
description: Financial planning, resource allocation, and supervisory audit controls to prevent data tampering and field inefficiencies.

proficiency_levels.Beginner: 25-40: Maintains field expense logs and tracks CAPI equipment inventory.
proficiency_levels.Intermediate: 41-65: Audits field sample coverage, verifies enumerator daily logs, and manages sub-district budgets.
proficiency_levels.Advanced: 66-85: Conducts independent quality audits, re-interview statistics, and financial control reviews.
proficiency_levels.Expert: 86-100: Oversees national survey expenditure control, audit compliance, and resource allocation.
